hero.titre: The right solution for your size.
hero.texte: Hosted Voxfon for SMBs, 3CX for growing businesses, SIP trunking to keep your current system: BV Communications gives your business the right VoIP solution for your needs.
hero.alt: Person seen from behind wearing a headset, waves of light across the room

voip.texte: VoIP stands for Voice over Internet Protocol: phone service through the internet. The technology has moved past simply replacing traditional telephones to adding voice and video calling to messaging, driven by connected devices and a far lower cost than copper wire phone service.
voip.alt: Business traveler on the phone in an airport

voxfon.titre: Hosted Voxfon: big features, small price.
voxfon.texte: Voxfon has taken the complexities out of hosted business VoIP: no more vague pricing plans and extra charges for features you need. All Voxfon plans come fully featured with options like find-me-follow-me, voicemail to email, remote extensions and much more.
voxfon.alt: Small team in a bright office, one person on a call with a headset

troiscx.titre: 3CX: the platform that grows with you.
troiscx.texte: 3CX is a software-based, open-standards IP PBX with unified communications built in. It runs on your servers or in the cloud, on Windows or Linux, integrates with popular CRM systems and Microsoft Teams, and works with a wide range of IP phones, softphones and iOS and Android apps.
troiscx.partenaire: BV Communications is a certified 3CX Platinum Partner Integrator.
troiscx.prix: Licences based on simultaneous calls: quoted on request.
troiscx.captureApp: 3CX app on desktop, IP phone and mobile

sip.titre: SIP trunking: keep your system, change your bill.
sip.texte: SIP trunking, or virtual phone lines, delivers superior call quality and brings Internet telephony to a wide variety of phone systems. You get the savings while protecting the investment in your current system. Our implementation team assesses adding IP trunk line cards to your system, or installs a gateway at your location giving you access to BV Communications’ private and secure SIP network.
sip.alt: Data center aisle between server racks

cprst.titre: Commission for Complaints for Telecom-television Services (CCTS)
cprst.texte: The CCTS is an independent agency that resolves, free of charge, consumer complaints about telecom and TV services, and small business complaints about telecom services. You must first try to resolve your complaint directly with your service provider; if you cannot reach a satisfactory resolution, the CCTS may be able to help. Toll-free: 1 888 221-1687.

crtc.texte: The CRTC is the public organization that regulates broadcasting and telecommunications in Canada. It took over responsibility for regulating telecommunication carriers in 1976. Toll-free: 1 877 249-2782.

avis911.intro: Text to be provided by BV Communications before launch.

pourquoi.texte: The CRTC requires local VoIP service providers to inform their customers, before service starts, of the availability, characteristics and limitations of their 9-1-1 or E9-1-1 service (Telecom Decisions 2005-21 and 2005-61), and to obtain their express consent where limitations exist.
